name: Chikatetsu-Akatsuka
tagline: Shinjuku in 29 minutes and Shibuya in 36 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, where Tobu and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 36 minutes to Shibuya and 50 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 34.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 34.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 31.7 m to 35.7 m, a difference of 4.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 下赤塚駅南口店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 18 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 練馬光が丘病院, about 22 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 成増厚生病院, about 35 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Tobu Tojo Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (Tobu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺; trains from here toward 護国寺 pass through it. Tobu Tojo Line runs at 131%. Trains from here toward 池袋 also pass through its busiest stretch, 北池袋→池袋. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Trains from here toward 池袋 also pass through its busiest stretch, 要町→池袋. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. 3 lines and a wide choice of connections and a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, many bars by the station and voices outside late at night holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Narimasu; for the number of medical facilities, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Chikatetsu-Akatsuka in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Chikatetsu-Akatsuka. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On quiet, Narimasu comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Tobu-Nerima; for how little of the area is in the flood projection, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Chikatetsu-Akatsuka in a straight line. Both have the Tobu Tojo Line. Chikatetsu-Akatsuka also has the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, which Tobu-Nerima does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On the number of medical facilities, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka has 41 clinics and pharmacies and Tobu-Nerima has 17.

noiseSources: 川越街道 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
北町豊玉線 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 15 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning trains are very crowded: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line trains toward 護国寺 pass through the line's busiest stretch further on.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
